# Impact Media GTA

> Impact Media GTA is a content agency in the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada, for service-based businesses. It films on location at the client's business with professional videographers, edits all footage with its own in-house team of editors, and runs the client's social media accounts and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns. One team handles the whole process from shoot to posting.

Owned by Ryan Adamson and Milano S. Also known as Impact Media Group. Based in Toronto; serves the Greater Toronto Area, including Mississauga, Vaughan, Markham and Brampton.

## Pricing

Packages start at $1,000 CAD.

## Services

- On-site content shoots: professional videographers film at the client's location — their team, space and work in action. No studio needed.
- In-house video editing: every clip is edited by Impact Media's own editors, with colour, sound, captions and pacing made for social media.
- Social media management: end-to-end management of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including posting schedule, captions, replies to comments and monthly reporting.
- Meta ads management: paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram built on the content Impact Media shoots, including targeting, creative testing and budget management.

## How it works

1. A shoot day at the client's location; the shot list is planned around their services, people and customers.
2. The editing team turns the footage into a library of short-form videos, reels and ad creative, ready to post.
3. Impact Media publishes and manages the client's social accounts and runs Meta ad campaigns.

## Who it works with

Service businesses, including auto detailers, cosmetic clinics and med spas, landscaping and hardscaping companies, contractors and trades, gyms and fitness studios, salons and barbershops, real estate teams, and restaurants and cafés.

## Client results

- D Shine Details (mobile auto detailing), owner, five-star Google review: "Impact Media came to our mobile detailing sites, filmed all our work, handled the editing, and our meta ads. After around 3 weeks of running meta ads I got fully booked out for details and had to stop accepting new clients for the month and half of next month. They made it super easy didn’t have to film or edit anything ourselves."

- Richmond Hill Health And Cosmetic Clinic (cosmetic clinic), five-star Google review: "The team at impact media helped me out with my business tons when we weren’t getting any clients or bookings, we started working with impact they came to our clinic, shot content for us, then edited them and also ran the meta ads which were amazing and got us almost fully booked out for the month! I recommend these guys to anyone struggling to get bookings or anyone who wants more bookings"
